rounds.reviewer: independent review agent (separate context, read-only), before any run
rounds.scope: commit db8d9fbbe vs the v2 head 0d8e2755e
rounds.verdictOfReviewer: do not run as pre-registered until P3-01..P3-05 are fixed (fixing after the run would be post-result tuning)

findings.finding: the conventional-ratio check was vacuous (list + 25 % tolerance covers every ratio 3..3000) and the event-day volume test classed real crashes on sqrt(R)..3R volume as FORWARD_SPLIT
findings.resolution: split signature = event-day mechanical volume AND share volume persistently scaled by R (1/R) over the next 10 sessions; GENUINE_MOVE = event-day share volume >= 3x; crash tests P3-01, P3-01b

findings.finding: hold labels could reuse the FINRA row or share count that created the hold
findings.resolution: labels blank every channel present in the decision's sources (labels.mjs excludedBy); counts in labelChannelsExcluded

findings.finding: FINRA as SECOND_SOURCE corroboration was reused as TP label; dependent TP evidence could override independent FP evidence
findings.resolution: FINRA blanked when it triggered or corroborated; vendor evaluated first

findings.finding: resume observedAt (second bar) could precede the observedAt of the hold that created the break
findings.resolution: observedAt = first as-of view containing the segment; test P3-04

findings.area: blinded set selected with mechanism output
findings.finding: segments flagged by the 1.2.0 core were excluded from the blinded set
findings.resolution: only the 83/74 V4 segments and the v2 members are excluded; core-flagged members reported as a stratum

findings.finding: the truncation comparison re-runs similar code; acceptance-time check universe-wide; skipped observedAt items silent
findings.resolution: comparison reported as consistency check; acceptance-time gate on decision observations; skipped items counted

findings.finding: OUTSIDE_VALID padded the denominator; FINRA/share events are engine inputs
findings.resolution: OUTSIDE_VALID not evaluable; gates on engine-independent (vendor) events

findings.finding: a DC row moving the ex-date became a second event
findings.resolution: corrections and cancellations join the announced event; test P3-08

findings.finding: vacuous passes (FINRA parse, D2 empty, empty categories, engine-own UNRESOLVED, diluted FP denominator)
findings.resolution: gates tightened as listed in the protocol's preRunReview

findings.finding: resumable semantic holds drop a real crash day while both sides stay usable
findings.resolution: resumed bars reported by the label of the break; segments must never be chained (contract and consumer matrix)

findings.finding: universe metrics are in-sample for rules motivated by v2 aggregates; the authoring session could decrypt per-case results
findings.resolution: verdict pre-committed from public counts (VERDICT-PRECOMMIT.json) before any decryption; universe metrics labelled in-sample

findings.finding: separate captures per collection job; SOURCES_DISAGREE observedAt
findings.resolution: one prepare job shares ciks.json; conflict visible when both sources are published
